responsibility: This file implements a tiny time-to-text helper for the mc-boot runtime. It retrieves a C-library formatted time string via the wrapc layer and copies it into a caller-supplied character array with ASCII_nul termination, providing the runtime's fixed-buffer interface for obtaining a printable current-time string rather than general date/time arithmetic.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation half of the GTimeString pair: it performs the actual wrapc_strtime call and copies the returned C string into the caller buffer with ASCII_nul termination, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GTimeString.h only declares that single entry point.
